title: AWS_DATA_LAKE_AND_FEATURE_STORE_PLAN
universal_lens: The AWS data lake architecture is mathematically formalized as a filtered measure space. The source rights registry defines a characteristic function over the raw data manifold, projecting only permitted elements into the S3 storage bucket. This induces a hierarchical sigma-algebra separating raw, normalized, and derived artifacts.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, the feature store acts as a conditional expectation operator. Each extracted feature is a random variable conditioned on the attached rights snapshot and extraction timestamp. Conformal inference bounds are strictly applied to derived features, ensuring predictive uncertainty respects the underlying contractual constraints.
gse_mapping: For GSE, the data pipeline represents a constrained state-transition system. Valid transitions occur only when the current state satisfies the source rights registry. Blocked operations, such as training on disabled sources, act as absorbing states that halt situational reasoning and prevent invalid model updates.

primitives.name: Rights Projection Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Allowed design: - Store only data permitted by the source rights registry.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: R: Source rights registry (dimensionless boolean set), D: Raw data stream (dimensionless), P_R: Characteristic projection operator (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: The rights registry R is deterministic and fully evaluated prior to any data ingestion event.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System singularity occurs if R contains contradictory permissions or evaluates to an indeterminate state for a given data packet.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to the GSI compliance filter, mapping raw telemetry directly into the valid feature subspace while discarding unauthorized signals.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of rejected data packets to total ingestion attempts.

primitives.name: Attribution Embedding Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Attach source id, rights snapshot, extraction timestamp, and attribution metadata.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: s: Source ID (string/dimensionless), r_t: Rights snapshot at time t (boolean vector), t_e: Extraction timestamp (seconds), A: Attribution metadata (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: All embedded metadata fields are immutable once written to the Glue catalog and perfectly synchronized across partitions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breakdown occurs under clock skew where extraction timestamps violate causal ordering, or if the rights snapshot becomes desynchronized from the actual registry.

layer2.mapping: Maps to the GSE provenance tracking layer, enabling exact reconstruction of the derivation code path and drift monitoring ownership.
layer2.telemetry: Metadata completeness rate and timestamp synchronization variance.

primitives.name: Storage Absorbing State
primitives.verbatim_quote: Blocked: - Storing raw data from sources with storage disabled.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S: Storage permission flag (boolean), dX: Differential data element (dimensionless), I: Identity operator (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: The transition to the blocked state is instantaneous and irreversible once the storage disabled flag is detected.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity arises if a race condition allows partial writes to S3 before the blocking mechanism evaluates the disabled flag.

layer2.mapping: Directly maps to the GSE forbidden state-transition matrix, acting as a hard boundary condition preventing illegal memory allocations in the engine.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of triggered blocking events and zero-byte artifact generation.

The architectural specification of the AWS Data Lake establishes a rigorous mathematical framework for handling high-dimensional sports telemetry under strict legal constraints. We begin by defining the raw data universe as a continuous stream of unstructured tensors. The 'source rights registry' functions as a global characteristic function, effectively projecting this infinite-dimensional space onto a finite, legally compliant subspace. This projection operator ensures that the resulting S3 buckets and Glue catalogs only contain elements belonging to the permitted set. 

Simultaneously, the requirement to attach source IDs, rights snapshots, and extraction timestamps introduces a fiber bundle structure over the base manifold of stored features. Every data point is not merely a value but a section of this bundle, carrying essential topological information regarding its origin and temporal validity. This is crucial for the Galaxy Sports Engine's situational reasoning, as it allows the system to trace the exact derivation code path of any computed metric.

The 'blocked' conditions define the boundaries of our state-transition diagram. When a source has storage disabled, the system enters an absorbing state where the identity operator is replaced by a null projection. This prevents any leakage of unauthorized raw data into the downstream feature store. Mathematically, this acts as a hard constraint optimization problem, where the objective is to maximize feature utility subject to the binary constraints imposed by the registry. Failure modes, such as race conditions during ingestion or clock skew affecting extraction timestamps, represent singularities in this smooth manifold, requiring robust error-handling kernels to maintain system stability.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This primitive lineage traces back to Shannon's information theory, specifically the concept of channel capacity constrained by external filters. It further evolves through the development of secure multi-party computation and modern differential privacy frameworks. reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the interaction between the data engineer, the legal compliance officer, and the machine learning algorithm as a multi-agent game. The engineer seeks to maximize feature richness, while the compliance officer acts as a minimizer of legal risk, enforcing the rights registry. The ML algorithm is a passive observer attempting to infer patterns within the constrained subspace. The attribution metadata serves as a communication protocol between these agents, ensuring that the algorithm's predictions can be retroactively audited by the compliance actor without revealing proprietary derivation logic.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity vetoes are critical when merging features from disparate sources with overlapping rights restrictions. If two independent data streams share a common, disabled upstream dependency, their combined representation in the feature store must trigger a veto to prevent implicit leakage. Furthermore, we enforce strict isolation between the raw and derived layers; no derived feature may inadvertently reconstruct the raw signal if the original source was flagged with model training disabled, thereby preventing reverse-engineering attacks on the protected data manifold.
